{{Quote|You seem a bit too simple-minded to be a politician. Therefore you wouldn't be in league with my rival in office.|Karin Featherlight|<ref name="SWG:KF" />}}
'''Karin Featherlight''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she was present in the Corellian [[City/Legends|capital city]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]], where she was campaigning for an election. During that time, Featherlight met an adventurer and told him that her supporters once discovered the [[Drall Patriot's Cave]] and the [[Rogue CorSec Base]] while campaigning across the planet.<ref name="SWG:KF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Karin Featherlight was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:KF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Karin Featherlight was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 5 Notes: 16 December 03|Publish 5]]" update, released on [[December 16]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 5: Vehicles">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60892|text=Publish 5: Vehicles}}</ref>
